Names of Data Objects Included in the PREVAIL Package

rds_names.Rd

Provides the names of datasets included in the PREVAIL package. Useful for users to quickly reference and access internal data resources.

Usage

rds_names

Format

A character vector with 13 elements:

contact_matricies

Contact matrices describing mixing patterns between age groups.

disease_parameters

Disease-specific parameters used in transmission modeling.

fertility

Fertility rates data.

full_disease_df

Complete dataframe containing disease metadata and parameters.

migration

Migration data including numbers and distributions.

mortality

Mortality rate data.

population_all

Total population data by age and location.

population_female

Female-specific population data by age and location.

routine_vaccination_data

Data on routine vaccination coverage.

sia_vaccination

Data on supplementary immunization activities (SIAs).

vaccination_pre1980

Historical vaccination data prior to 1980.

vaccination_schedule

Recommended vaccination schedules.

vaccine_parameters

Parameters describing vaccine characteristics and efficacy.

Source

PREVAIL internal datasets
